slim_popcount.name: slim_popcount
slim_popcount.note: Drops the 64 KiB comptime popcount table for @popCount per byte.

slim_checksum.name: slim_checksum
slim_checksum.note: One u64 checksum loop truncated to each width (wrapping multiply-add commutes with truncation) and one hex formatter with a runtime width, instead of eight instantiations of each.

perf_popcount64.name: perf_popcount64
perf_popcount64.note: Counts eight bytes per @popCount on a little-endian u64 load instead of one table lookup per two bytes.

equiv_change.name: equiv_change
equiv_change.note: Drops the table but counts only the low seven bits of each byte. The unit tests only use ASCII, so they pass; seeded random bytes do not.

regress.name: regress
regress.note: Widens the table entries to u16 'to avoid a widening load'; the table doubles to 128 KiB.

break_tests.name: break_tests
break_tests.note: Drops the table and counts 16 bits at a time, but forgets a trailing odd byte.
